title: Inter-agency security alert
description: A security alert shared among agencies' security focal points: what was reported, how reliable it is, the recommended actions at the level of movement and programme decisions, and how long it is valid. Sharing an alert does not transfer responsibility for any organization's staff security. Organizations are fictional.

examples: Shared with the inter-agency security channel
Security focal points of NGOs and UN agencies in Karun Province

Two NGO vehicles were held for several hours at an unofficial checkpoint near Bel Ravi on 15 October. Both were released without injury. Reports of further informal checkpoints on Route 4 and Route 9 have not been confirmed.

recommended.description: Recommended actions for each organization to consider
examples: Review movements on Route 4 north of Bel Ravi.
Report further checkpoint sightings to the shared channel.
Brief drivers on the reporting steps.
Share with security focal points only. Do not forward outside the inter-agency security channel.
